name.title: Name
name.description: You shouldn't need to change this.

hideTemperatureSensor.title: Hide Fan Temperature Sensor
hideTemperatureSensor.description: Enable this option to hide the temperature sensor.

temperatureOffset.title: Fan Temperature Offset
temperatureOffset.description: Subtract (or add) a set amount from the temperature reading (use negative numbers to subtract). This setting only applies to fans.

commandIntervalMs.title: Command Interval (ms)
commandIntervalMs.description: Minimum time between two commands to the same device, so scenes aren't dropped. 0 turns pacing off.

commandCoalesceMs.title: Command Merge Window (ms)
commandCoalesceMs.description: Writes to the same device within this window are sent as one command. Never more than the command interval.

commandConfirmTimeoutMs.title: Command Confirm Timeout (ms)
commandConfirmTimeoutMs.description: Resend a command once if the device hasn't confirmed it within this time. 0 turns resending off.
